member.name: M:OutSystems.NssFormatCurrency.IssFormatCurrency.MssGetDecimalFromLocaleDecimalString(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.Boolean@,System.Int32@,System.String@,System.Decimal@)
member.summary:
Converts a Locale Decimal String (a decimal that was written in in a certain locale) into a valid Decimal.
For now "zh" locale that uses the extended numbers and financial numbers will not be converted.
Error Message Codes and meanings: 0 - "" - No Error 1 - "String Empty" - The string was empty 2 - "Locale Invalid/Not Provided" - No Locale was found 3 - "FormatException [x]" - an error in the format of the number - log represented in x 4 - "Other Errors [x]" - other errors - log represented in x
member.param: The String containing the Locale Decimal to convert into Decimal
The Locale that the string was written on. (It will try both native and 0-9 numbers from the locale).
If filled it will use the provided as the currency symbol of the locale instead of the locale's currency
If the converted Decimal is a valid one, if not then the Error Message will have the reason that the conversion failed.
The code of the Error Message.
Error Message in case the converted Decimal is not valid.
The Decimal converted, if the IsValidDecimal is notTrue, then this will be the default value 0.0.
